description: Security check of a web app built with AI: exposed secrets in the browser bundle, Supabase tables readable without login, open Firebase databases, published .env or .git files, and missing headers. Each finding has a fix. The app owner must publish a verification token first; get it with POST /app-check/token. An unverified app is not charged. Price: 0.250 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.
name: security_app_check
